<description>
**Problem:** Loading a UTXO snapshot on a pruned node can leave the active tip without block or undo data. Attempting a rollback with `dumptxoutset` then triggers an assertion and terminates the node.

**Fix:** Reuse `GetPruneHeight` to reject rollback with the existing pruning error when the required data is unavailable.
</description>

<commits>
bef6e5abaa test: characterize snapshot rollback without tip data

Record the assertion when the snapshot tip lacks block data or undo, then restart the node to continue the existing checks.

3cb70c28f5 rpc: reject snapshot rollback without tip data

Reuse GetPruneHeight to return the existing pruning error when the snapshot tip lacks block or undo data.
</commits>

<patch>
diff --git a/src/rpc/blockchain.cpp b/src/rpc/blockchain.cpp
index e544b4868a..9fbc0f55ed 100644
--- a/src/rpc/blockchain.cpp
+++ b/src/rpc/blockchain.cpp
@@ -3193,9 +3193,7 @@ static RPCMethod dumptxoutset()
         std::optional<TemporaryPruneLock> temp_prune_lock;
         if (node.chainman->m_blockman.IsPruneMode()) {
             LOCK(node.chainman->GetMutex());
-            const CBlockIndex* current_tip{node.chainman->ActiveChain().Tip()};
-            const CBlockIndex& first_block{node.chainman->m_blockman.GetFirstBlock(*current_tip, /*status_mask=*/BLOCK_HAVE_MASK)};
-            if (first_block.nHeight > target_index->nHeight) {
+            if (GetPruneHeight(node.chainman->m_blockman, chainstate.m_chain).value_or(0) >= target_index->nHeight) {
                 throw JSONRPCError(RPC_MISC_ERROR, "Could not roll back to requested height since necessary block data is already pruned.");
             }
             temp_prune_lock.emplace(node.chainman->m_blockman, target_index->nHeight);
diff --git a/test/functional/feature_assumeutxo.py b/test/functional/feature_assumeutxo.py
index 8727a9925e..3804a61d23 100755
--- a/test/functional/feature_assumeutxo.py
+++ b/test/functional/feature_assumeutxo.py
@@ -528,6 +528,10 @@ class AssumeutxoTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         assert_equal(loaded['coins_loaded'], SNAPSHOT_BASE_HEIGHT)
         assert_equal(loaded['base_height'], SNAPSHOT_BASE_HEIGHT)
 
+        self.log.info("Check snapshot rollback with unavailable block or undo data")
+        assert_raises_rpc_error(-1, "Could not roll back to requested height since necessary block data is already pruned.",
+                                n1.dumptxoutset, 'rollback.dat', rollback=SNAPSHOT_BASE_HEIGHT - 1)
+
         self.log.info("Confirm that local services remain unchanged")
         # Since n1 is a pruned node, the 'NETWORK' service flag must always be unset.
         self.assert_only_network_limited_service(n1)
@@ -677,6 +681,20 @@ class AssumeutxoTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         snapshot_block = n0.getblock(snapshot_hash, 0)
         n1.submitblock(snapshot_block)
 
+        self.log.info("Check snapshot rollback through the snapshot block, which has no undo data")
+        assert_raises_rpc_error(-1, "Undo data not available", n1.getblockstats, snapshot_hash)
+        assert_raises_rpc_error(-1, "Could not roll back to requested height since necessary block data is already pruned.",
+                                n1.dumptxoutset, 'rollback_body.dat', rollback=SNAPSHOT_BASE_HEIGHT - 1)
+
+        self.log.info("Check snapshot rollback from a tip with block data but no undo")
+        first_snapshot_child = n1.getblockhash(SNAPSHOT_BASE_HEIGHT + 1)
+        n1.invalidateblock(first_snapshot_child)
+        assert_equal(n1.getbestblockhash(), snapshot_hash)
+        assert_equal(n1.getblock(snapshot_hash, 0), snapshot_block)
+        assert_raises_rpc_error(-1, "Could not roll back to requested height since necessary block data is already pruned.",
+                                n1.dumptxoutset, 'rollback_tip.dat', rollback=SNAPSHOT_BASE_HEIGHT - 1)
+        n1.reconsiderblock(first_snapshot_child)
+
         self.connect_nodes(0, 1)
 
         self.log.info(f"Ensuring snapshot chain syncs to tip. ({FINAL_HEIGHT})")
